messages.author: Saoirse Lindgren
messages.text: INC-70866 is not charged — PRB-4121 reclassified it. The March 26 quorum loss (26 minutes) leaves the 30-day window on the 25th.

messages.author: Adaeze Nkemelu
messages.text: Orrinwave will not support a split upgrade: mixed-version clusters are unsupported, so all three brokers restart in one session.

messages.author: Tunde Abara
messages.text: A budget exception for an earlier date would be mine and nobody has asked. The notice length is what customer comms publish, so it has to fit the budget as a whole.
